name: hc-email-smtp-errors
prompt: Bug: when the SMTP server is unreachable or misbehaves — the server disconnects, refuses the connection, or rejects the message data — sending an email notification crashes instead of being recorded as a failed delivery. Expected: the email integration catches these SMTP and connection errors, records the notification's error as exactly "SMTP connection error", and logs the exception (with logger.exception) instead of crashing.
